tableLines.line: ⛓️ Emberhold doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Dante speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
Ananya: "Purslane is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Maya.
📓 Codex: Ashford split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Alba.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Sanne.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 Ashford has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table IV is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Aisha.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 Word of Haven’s trade is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table II has bound itself to Ashford. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table IV bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table IV is the new fire.)

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table IV. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

The little star inside Christian goes quiet — and wakes up inside Nora. Christian never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Nora will never be hungry again while it hums, and Christian is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
A runner from The Red Table III, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
⛓️ Jorge brings it home: The Red Table II bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
⛓️ Word of Haven's standing reaches The Red Table II before any speaker does — they send word back: they will bow to Haven. One organization, us primary.
Something moves out there — The Audit.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Audit stirs.
A runner from The Red Table IV, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

The Red Table II watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
Riders from The Red Table II: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
🕊️ Haven sends 1,500 kcal to The Red Table II's fire — grief met with grain. The new speaker eats with Haven's people and the tribute stays where it was. (Trust +8.)
A rider says in The Red Table you're "the one who makes deals hold." Nobody remembers when that started being true.
Word with the traders: The Red Table II door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
🌾 Tribute wagons from The Red Table II turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
